questions.q: What are the four layers of life in the authors' model?
a: Autopilot, effectiveness, self-awareness, self-transcendence
Survival, comfort, success, legacy
Body, mind, heart, spirit
Habits, goals, values, beliefs
questions.why: The first lesson describes four levels, from acting on habits down to testing a vision against what is truly worth wanting.

questions.q: What happens at the self-transcendence level?
a: We ask what is worth wanting and test our vision against truth
We follow our habits without stopping to question them
We compare our goals with other people's achievements
We set a strategy for reaching a goal efficiently
questions.why: At the deepest level, the authors say we test whether the vision we have formed is actually true.

questions.q: How does the effectiveness level differ from the autopilot level?
a: Autopilot follows habits while effectiveness questions whether they work
Autopilot is reflection while effectiveness is pure action
Autopilot concerns values while effectiveness concerns truth
Autopilot is a daily state while effectiveness is a yearly review
questions.why: At that level we review our strategies and ask whether our actions are producing the results we want.

questions.q: What does the summary say about a good life versus an easy life?
a: A good life may require sacrifice and is not always easy
A good life is simply a long, healthy and happy one
A good life avoids suffering through strict discipline
A good life is whichever life feels most pleasant
questions.why: Drawing on Oscar Wilde and the Buddha, the authors conclude that a worthwhile life is not the same as a comfortable one.

questions.q: What is the Examen, one of the book's three exercises?
a: A five-step daily ritual of gratitude, review and forgiveness
A weekly fast followed by silent reflection
A meditation focused on one philosophical question
A written plan for the year ahead
questions.why: The third lesson describes a 15-minute daily routine of gratitude, review and forgiveness, attributed to Saint Ignatius.
